payload.name: MCP Agents Take Part in a Walk Without Becoming Part of Its Control Flow
payload.description: An MCP call can be the prompt. The agents that started or joined a walk follow it through a feed, and a step waits on an agent only when its provider names one. Everything else about the walk runs as before.

principles.name: Additive, opt-in
principles.description: Participation adds awareness and an optional provider; a walk that names no agent behaves exactly as it did.

heuristics.action: submit it as a prompt and let the walk route tools rather than calling capability servers directly
show it as an awaiting item; do not add a timeout

decision_rules.name: A call can be the prompt
decision_rules.condition: an MCP agent starts a walk
decision_rules.outcome: record the caller and any named participants with the walk and give them the walk's trace from the first instant

decision_rules.name: Follow by cursor
decision_rules.outcome: read the append-only feed from a cursor instead of polling raw endpoints; the feed is never rotated or capped and a lagging reader gets an explicit gap row

decision_rules.name: Agent steps wait
decision_rules.condition: a step's provider is an agent
decision_rules.outcome: create a durable request and wait for the agent's report with no timeout and no fail-open; completed is final and a rerun is a new request

decision_rules.name: Identity is bound
decision_rules.condition: agents act through an MCP server
decision_rules.outcome: bind one process to one agent identity and key; the host records the validated device where it can

decision_rules.name: Keep prompt text out of shared notes
decision_rules.condition: a walk is announced to shared context
decision_rules.outcome: write hashes, ids and names only to git-visible notes; walk rows with stage text live in a git-ignored folder

decision_rules.name: Operator-only stays operator-only
decision_rules.condition: an agent tool surface is defined
decision_rules.outcome: do not expose marketplace decisions, task cancel, configuration, policy changes or restore
